canonical_term: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt base-game launch narrative
definition: The selected original Wild Hunt game-release narrative, officially scheduled to unlock on 19 May 2015.
cultural_caution: This scope excludes later patches, the Complete Edition, two expansions, Netflix-inspired additions, integrated mods, and other media continuities.

definition: A professional monster slayer for hire, exemplified by Geralt, trained from childhood and mutated to have superhuman abilities.
cultural_caution: A source-specific profession and transformation context; witchers are not generic character nodes, and this page does not document schools or every witcher's history.

citations.locator: Official page, Become The Witcher and Characters: Geralt
supports: Witcher profession, monster-slayer role, childhood training, and mutation

definition: A brutal warband of spectral riders led by King Eredin and pursuing Ciri's power in the official base-game premise.
cultural_caution: An organization/warband, not a collective-character record or a source for unshown member identities.

citations.locator: Official page, Forge a Legendary Tale and Characters: Eredin
supports: Wild Hunt description, objective, and Eredin's kingship

definition: The dark-fantasy world named by the official page, encompassing the regions Velen, Novigrad, and Skellige in the stated overview.
cultural_caution: A game-world setting label, not evidence that game geography and every book/adaptation depiction are identical.

citations.locator: Official page, Embark on the Path and Explore a Dark Fantasy Open World
supports: Continent and the listed base-game regions

definition: Preparatory combat resources described alongside the witcher's paired swords.
cultural_caution: A gameplay/tool description, not an assertion that all named characters can use alchemy or that all game builds employ identical equipment.

supports: Elixirs, blade oils, silver sword for monsters, and steel sword for humans

original_script: silver for monsters, steel for humans
definition: The two-sword combat distinction stated in the official page: silver against monsters and steel against humans.
cultural_caution: A general witcher combat presentation, not individual named artifacts or a proof of every character's loadout.

definition: The official page says player decisions carry ramifications for Geralt, allies, enemies, and the world.
cultural_caution: This prohibits converting one player path, romance, ending, survival state, or quest decision into an unconditional canonical character fact.

citations.locator: Official page, Explore a Dark Fantasy Open World

definition: One of Ciri's explicitly named designations in the official character panel.
cultural_caution: The designation is retained as source terminology; this pass does not import book-derived prophecy mechanics or ontology.
